title: Source ID prefixes
description: Allowed source ID prefixes and formats for citations in location and media records.

openbibleSourceId.description: OpenBible.info Bible Geocoding url_slug, for example openbible:capernaum.

pleiadesSourceId.description: Pleiades numeric place ID, for example pleiades:678231.

dareSourceId.description: Digital Atlas of the Roman Empire numeric ID, for example dare:21094.

osmSourceId.description: OpenStreetMap element identifier, for example osm:way/123456789.

naturalEarthSourceId.description: Natural Earth feature ne_id, for example naturalearth:1159152091.

commonsSourceId.description: Wikimedia Commons file title, for example commons:File:Example.jpg.

orbisSourceId.description: ORBIS dataset ID, for example orbis:1234.

awmcSourceId.description: AWMC feature ID, for example awmc:1234.

wikipediaSourceId.description: Wikipedia article title for citation only, for example wikipedia:Capernaum.

perseusSourceId.description: Perseus CTS URN for citation only, for example perseus:urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0526.

bibliographySourceId.description: Bibliography registry key, for example bib:pleiades-place-resource.

sourceId.description: A citation ID that uses one of the approved prefixes.
